# Chapter 8 — 让我想想再告诉你 (Let Me Think About It and Tell You Later)

**Pinyin:** Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosu nǐ  
**Source:** *HSK Standard Course 2*, printed pages 57–64 (source image pages 077–084).

## New Words

| No. | Chinese | Pinyin | English | Source |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 再 | zài | adv. again; once more | p. 58 |
| 2 | 让 | ràng | v. to let; to allow | p. 58 |
| 3 | 告诉 | gàosu | v. to tell | p. 58 |
| 4 | 等 | děng | v. to wait; to await | p. 58 |
| 5 | 找 | zhǎo | v. to look for | p. 58 |
| 6 | 事情 | shìqing | n. thing; matter; affair | p. 58 |
| 7 | 服务员 | fúwùyuán | n. attendant; waiter/waitress | p. 59 |
| 8 | 白 | bái | adj. white | p. 59 |
| 9 | 黑 | hēi | adj. black | p. 59 |
| 10 | 贵 | guì | adj. expensive | p. 59 |

## Unique Hanzi in New Words

Distinct characters in the numbered New Words entries, listed once in order of first appearance: **再、让、告、诉、等、找、事、情、服、务、员、白、黑、贵** (14 characters).

The warm-up on p. 57 includes picture labels such as **电影、天气、运动、服务员、等、白** and antonym prompts including **大、多、快、冷、上、长、少、慢、热**. These are exercise prompts, not additional numbered New Words entries.

## Characters

The Characters section on printed p. 63 introduces two radicals:

- **又** (又字旁): its meanings vary; example characters **欢** (huān, merry; happy) and **对** (duì, right; correct).
- **巾** (巾字底): often associated with cotton, silk, or textiles; example characters **帮** (bāng, to help; to aid) and **帽** (mào, hat; cap).

These are the Characters-page radicals and examples; they are separate from the ten numbered New Words.
